claims.explanation: Parachlorophenol is a phenolic mitochondrial uncoupler/cytotoxin. Sensitivity is enriched in lines with mutations in chromatin-remodeling genes (FBXW7, EP300, SMARCA4, KMT2D, KMT2C, ARID1A) and KRAS, which may increase dependence on oxidative phosphorylation or impair stress responses. Resistance is associated with NF2 and CTNNB1 mutations, possibly via YAP/Wnt-mediated survival.
